QuestInfo.name: Makeup Artist, Booked!
QuestInfo.0: You booked a makeup artist. Report the good news to #bLana#k.
QuestInfo.1: This time, you must book a hair stylist. Go over to #bMarshall#k and ask for help.
QuestInfo.2: #bMarshall#k says he can't design Blake's hair. Why not? This can't be good. Discuss it with #bLana#k.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 1,250\nCan proceed to the Marshall's Refusal quest\n

0.0: So? Did Tina agree to the job?\r\n#L0##bYes, Tina the makeup artist has agreed to take the job. She also wanted me to thank you for the gig.#l\n#k
0.1: I knew she'd agree, ha. Okay! Next on the list is...getting a hair stylist. You can do it, can't you?

yes.0: I must have Marshall do Blake's hair. None of my stars get in front of an audience until Marshall's had his way with their hair. Please convince #bMarshall#k to help.

no.0: What, you don't think you can do it? This should be easy...

1.0: Bonjour. Do I know you? Apologies, but I am not working at the moment. Please...please just leave.\r\n#L0##bHi, I'm #h0#. I'm here to ask you if you'd do Blake's hair. He's making his debut as a singer soon and could use your help.#l\n#k
1.1: Ah, yes. I have heard that. I would be delighted to help, but alas, I think I cannot. I am sorry.\r\n#L0##bIs something wrong? Is there anything I can do to help?#l\n#k
1.2: No, no. I cannot possibly ask for help from someone I have just met. Pardon me...

npc.0: Marshall is the best hair stylist in town. Please convince #bMarshall#k.
